# Notion API Limits Checklist: Notion client keeps to Notion's API limits

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for rate pacing, retries, size limits and paging
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. `[x]` means the criterion is satisfied in the spec/plan, not that implementation is complete.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` = reviewed and satisfied; a struck item (`~~`) does not apply, with its reason.

## Rate pacing

- [x] CHK001 Is the bucket capacity and sustained rate quantified, with the numbers that follow from them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated that retries and chunks pass through pacing too? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is the scope of the pacer (per client, not cross-process) and its fallback to the 429 retry stated? [Assumption, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the clock injectable so pacing is measurable without real time? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK005 Does a refused over-size body say whether it costs a bucket token? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Retries

- [x] CHK006 Is the retried set of answers enumerated, and the non-retried set too? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, US1 AS7]
- [x] CHK007 Is the `attempt` index in the backoff formula defined (0 before the first retry)? [Ambiguity, Spec US1 AS3] (fixed in spec and data-model)
- [x] CHK008 Is the jitter bounded and testable (injectable `random`, range stated)? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behaviour when a computed backoff or a server `Retry-After` exceeds the cap defined, and are the two distinguished? [Clarity, Spec US1 AS5]
- [x] CHK010 Are `Retry-After` edge values (non-numeric, HTTP date, negative, 0) defined? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases] (fixed)
- [x] CHK011 Are `NOTION_SYNC_MAX_RETRIES=0` and `NOTION_SYNC_MAX_WAIT_S=0` defined? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 Is the method-dependent retry of timeouts and network errors justified and unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Is the final error's name on exhausted retries specified? [Completeness, Spec US1 AS4]

## Size limits

- [x] CHK014 Is the unit of the 2,000 limit defined and used consistently across US2, FR-004 and FR-005? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications] (FR-005 and AS3 fixed from "characters" to code points)
- [x] CHK015 Is the failure for text needing over 100 objects specified as an error, not truncation? [Completeness, Spec US2 AS2, FR-004]
- [x] CHK016 Is the relation over 100 ids specified as refuse-not-truncate, with the boundary of exactly 100? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, US2 AS4]
- [x] CHK017 Is "500 KB" defined in bytes, encoding and serialisation, and the point where it is checked? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK018 Are the 100-children chunk order and target block specified? [Completeness, Spec US2 AS5, FR-007]
- [x] CHK019 Is the scope of the long-text fallback (comments, properties) versus the `markdown` page body bounded? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Are empty text and empty relation outcomes defined? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Paging

- [x] CHK021 Is `page_size: 100` required on every page request, with the caller-override rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, US3 AS2]
- [x] CHK022 Is the block-children read's page size required in the same terms? [Consistency, Spec US3 AS3]
- [x] CHK023 Is the relation of `page_size` to the existing `NOTION_SYNC_MAX_PAGES` cap stated? [Clarity, Spec US3]

## Scope, consistency and measurability

- [x] CHK024 Are the out-of-scope paths (MCP connector, other callers, new behaviour) named? [Coverage, Spec Scope]
- [x] CHK025 Does each FR map to an acceptance scenario and a success criterion? [Traceability, Spec FR-001..008, SC-001..005]
- [x] CHK026 Are the figures marked as Notion's documented limits, with the story as the source for the fixed ones? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 Are the plan's pacing, retry and body-check designs consistent with the spec's formulas and order of checks? [Consistency, Plan Design notes, Data model]
